name: Пастки: усунення захисника + WH
description: In this lesson, we continue focusing on disabling a defender to win material. We will now concentrate on the methods of driving away and luring away. It remains important to consider the basic forms of defense (moving away, covering, capturing, and interposing) as well as counterattacks, so the opponent cannot escape material loss.

examples.text:
Both 1.Ne4! and 1.Nh5 attack the queen, which is the defender of the bishop.

In the case of 1.Nh5 (red arrow), this is not sufficient. Black can move the queen and continue to protect the bishop: 1...Qg5! (green arrow).

1.Ne4, on the other hand, does win material. The knight not only attacks the queen but also takes away the g5 square from the queen.

1.e5 and 1.g5 are the candidate moves.

1.g5 (red arrow) allows a counterattack with 1...Qd4+. Due to the check, White has no time to capture the knight on e7.

The correct move is therefore 1.e5!. This move prevents 1...Qd4+. If the queen moves away, White captures the knight: 1.e5! Qg6 2.Qxe7.

texts: Drive away a key defender. Always ask yourself: what can the opponent do in response?
